```{r ,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=10,fig.width=8, out.width="100%"}

# ======================================================
# SES histogram + clustered categorical guild heatmap
# Pollinator + plant species counts in labels
# ======================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)

alpha <- 0.05
critical_value <- qnorm(0.975)
top_n_plants <- 18

cat_levels <- c("Avoidance", "No difference", "Preference")
cat_labels <- c("Avoidance", "No difference", "Preference")

plot_cols <- c(
  "Avoidance" = "#F1A340",
  "No difference" = "grey85",
  "Preference" = "#7B3294"
)

guild_order <- c(
  "Apidae", "Andrenidae", "Halictidae", "Megachilidae",
  "Colletidae", "Melittidae", "Non-bee Hymenoptera",
  "Bombylids", "Syrphids", "Other Diptera",
  "Lepidoptera", "Coleoptera", "Other taxa"
)

# -----------------------------
# Load data
# -----------------------------

SES <- readRDS("../Data/Working_files/SES_genus.rds")
SES_guild <- readRDS("../Data/Working_files/SES_guild_split_bees.rds")
pval_df_guild <- readRDS("../Data/Working_files/pval_df_guild_split_bees.rds")
raw_data <- readRDS("../Data/Working_files/interaction_data.rds")

# -----------------------------
# Count pollinator species per guild
# -----------------------------

poll_order <- c("Hymenoptera", "Diptera", "Coleoptera", "Lepidoptera")

bee_families <- c(
  "Apidae", "Andrenidae", "Halictidae",
  "Megachilidae", "Colletidae", "Melittidae"
)

guild_n_species <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Pollinator_accepted_name),
    Pollinator_rank == "SPECIES",
    Pollinator_order %in% poll_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pollinator_guild = case_when(
      Pollinator_order == "Hymenoptera" &
        Pollinator_family %in% bee_families ~ Pollinator_family,
      Pollinator_order == "Hymenoptera" ~ "Non-bee Hymenoptera",
      Pollinator_family == "Bombyliidae" ~ "Bombylids",
      Pollinator_family == "Syrphidae" ~ "Syrphids",
      Pollinator_order == "Diptera" ~ "Other Diptera",
      Pollinator_order == "Lepidoptera" ~ "Lepidoptera",
      Pollinator_order == "Coleoptera" ~ "Coleoptera",
      TRUE ~ "Other taxa"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(Pollinator_guild, Pollinator_accepted_name) %>%
  count(Pollinator_guild, name = "n_species")

# -----------------------------
# Count plant species per family
# -----------------------------

plant_n_species <- raw_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Plant_accepted_name)) %>%
  distinct(Plant_family, Plant_accepted_name) %>%
  count(Plant_family, name = "n_species")

# ======================================================
# A) SES histogram
# ======================================================

SES_df <- as.data.frame(SES) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Plant_family") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Plant_family, names_to = "Pollinator_genus", values_to = "SES") %>%
  filter(!is.na(SES)) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      SES < -critical_value ~ "Avoidance",
      SES >  critical_value ~ "Preference",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    ),
    category = factor(category, levels = cat_levels)
  )

x_lim <- quantile(abs(SES_df$SES), 0.85, na.rm = TRUE)

p_ses <- ggplot(SES_df, aes(x = SES, fill = category)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 1100,
    alpha = 0.9,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2,
    position = "identity"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-critical_value, critical_value),
    linetype = "longdash",
    colour = "grey35"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#3B3B3B") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plot_cols, guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-x_lim, x_lim), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Standardized effect size (SES)", y ="Count") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(size = 1.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black")
  )

# ======================================================
# B) Heatmap data
# ======================================================

heat_df <- as.data.frame(SES_guild) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Plant_family") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Plant_family, names_to = "Pollinator_guild", values_to = "SES") %>%
  left_join(pval_df_guild, by = c("Plant_family", "Pollinator_guild")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SES)) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      p_two < alpha & SES > 0 ~ "Avoidance",
      p_two < alpha & SES < 0 ~ "Preference",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    ),
    category = factor(category, levels = cat_levels)
  )

plant_keep <- heat_df %>%
  group_by(Plant_family) %>%
  summarise(signal = sum(abs(SES)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(signal, n = top_n_plants) %>%
  pull(Plant_family)

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  filter(Plant_family %in% plant_keep)

ses_mat <- heat_df %>%
  select(Plant_family, Pollinator_guild, SES) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Pollinator_guild, values_from = SES, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Plant_family") %>%
  as.matrix()

plant_order <- rownames(ses_mat)[hclust(dist(ses_mat))$order]

guild_labels <- guild_n_species %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(Pollinator_guild, " (", n_species, ")")) %>%
  select(Pollinator_guild, label) %>%
  deframe()

plant_labels <- plant_n_species %>%
  filter(Plant_family %in% plant_order) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(Plant_family, " (", n_species, ")")) %>%
  select(Plant_family, label) %>%
  deframe()

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  mutate(
    Plant_family = factor(
      Plant_family,
      levels = plant_order,
      labels = plant_labels[plant_order]
    ),
    Pollinator_guild = factor(
      Pollinator_guild,
      levels = rev(guild_order[guild_order %in% names(guild_labels)]),
      labels = rev(guild_labels[guild_order[guild_order %in% names(guild_labels)]])
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# C) Heatmap
# ======================================================

p_heat <- ggplot(
  heat_df,
  aes(x = Plant_family, y = Pollinator_guild, fill = category)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", alpha= 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plot_cols, name = "Observed against null") +
  labs(x = "Plant family", y = "Pollinator guild") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.background = element_rect(colour = "black"),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "black"),
    legend.margin = margin(4, 20, 4, 8)
  )

# ======================================================
# Combined plot
# ======================================================

p_ses <- p_ses +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1))

p_heat <- p_heat +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 5, 1, 1))

library(cowplot)

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  p_ses,
  p_heat,
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v",
  axis = "lr",
  rel_heights = c(1, 1),
  labels = c("a)", "b)"),        # labels here
  label_size = 24,             # adjust size
  label_fontface = "bold",
  label_x = c(0.15, 0.15),          # left aligned
  label_y = 1                  # top
)

combined_plot

```
